$comment: Best-practice skill sources for /skills-audit. Hazards here belong to the source itself; collisions with one repo's house rules are found per repo, never recorded here. audited.sha is the upstream commit an audit read (HEAD on its date). Sources: the HateDate RN skills audit (2026-09-08) and prizma commit 457cc0f.

skills.name: react-native-best-practices
skills.covers: Reanimated, gestures, SVG, worklets and multithreading, as reference sub-skills; from the libraries' maintainers

hazards.text: The marketplace version string stays at 0.1.0 across commits, so the plugin manager reports up to date; track by sha
Callstack ships a skill with the same name on the same trigger words; keep one
The multithreading and enable-worklets-bundle-mode references describe worklets 0.10+ and Reanimated 4.5+; check the installed versions

skills.name: react-native-best-practices
skills.covers: RN performance doctrine: measure, optimize, re-measure; bundle and startup

skills.name: react-native-testing
skills.covers: React Native Testing Library: queries, userEvent, matchers

skills.name: upgrading-react-native
skills.covers: RN version upgrades for projects that own their native folders

skills.name: agent-device
skills.covers: drives simulators and devices for testing

hazards.text: Same name as Software Mansion's skill on the same trigger words; keep one
Recommends React Compiler and Jotai, advises against useMemo/useCallback without profiling, and has a runOnJS sample and a Reanimated 3 install line
Edits native folders; under Expo CNG they are generated, and expo-upgrade applies instead
Bundled in testing-react-native-apps; it drives simulators and devices
Under expo-router most of it does not apply
Lists `eas update` as a version check; that command publishes an OTA update
Runs `expo install expo@latest` and questions every expo.install.exclude entry; reconcile with the repo's dependency policy first
Prefers .get()/.set() on shared values and Pressable plus CSS-transition press feedback; check against the repo's animation rules
Headline samples use NativeTabs and newer-SDK APIs; check against the installed SDK
Written for new projects; its src/app layout can invert an existing repo's
The plugin ships hooks/hooks.json (telemetry hooks, documented opt-in); read it before enabling an update
The official marketplace pinned an older commit (80090cc, 2026-09-02) than expo/skills HEAD; compare by sha, not plugin version

skills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
skills.covers: React and Next.js performance rules with ids; the performance reviewer cites them

skills.name: vercel-composition-patterns
skills.covers: component API design: compound components, no boolean props

skills.name: vercel-optimize
skills.covers: Vercel cost, cache-hit rate and Core Web Vitals, metric-first

hazards.text: Teaches runOnJS and pins Reanimated 3.16.1 as correct; some samples don't compile, and the repo's eval harness has no RN cases
Encourages deploying from a laptop; skip it in a repo that ships on merge
Encourages CLI deploys with tokens; skip it in a repo that ships on merge

Installed with `npx skills add`; skills-lock.json's computedHash covers the upstream folder (including a metadata.json it doesn't copy), so it can't verify a local copy. Record the sha and diff against a clone

audited.by: prizma 457cc0f and the HateDate RN skills audit
